purpose: Check an actual normal-mode Model block boundary and unmodified timeseries logging before developing the complete observer adapter. No electric plant or completed R2 physical case is run.
architecture: New child model with one scalar native-rate Inport and no Outport, child-owned workspace offset, native clock log, JEOS clock log and enabled completion log. New parent model supplies a constant and contains the Model block in Normal mode. Parent and child contain different values of the same workspace variable to test scope isolation.
checks: Parent SimulationOutput exposes all child timeseries with exact expected classes/dimensions; no logs silently missing or nested under unidentified instances
Native320001 points, JEOS400 points at462+800k ticks, completion400 points at510+800k ticks, exact integer times and preserved original values
Child offset1.234 is used together with parent input9.876 despite parent having offset100; child and parent workspaces unchanged after compile and simulation
No output ports is supported and the child sink/logging path still executes; all source, generated model and archive hashes retained
policy: One execution only, no numerical retries or labels. Retain pre-execution construction errors; any repair requires its own addendum before a separate first-valid-execution folder. No user original SLX save, feedback takeover, R2 performance verdict or final candidate freeze.
